I found six Airbnbs in Cleveland that match your dates and filters (22 homes matched in total, but the rest were different dates or ran past the budget). The dates are Nov 9 to 12, 2026, for 2 adults, 2 children and 1 pet. The filters were $100–$300 per night, free parking, a washer and a gym. I haven't booked anything.

Prices below are the 3-night totals with all fees included:

| Listing | Total (per night) | Details |
|---|---|---|
| **Downtown sports-themed loft** (top pick) | $377 (~$126) | 2 bed, 3 beds, 2 bath. 4.92 stars (13 reviews). Guest favorite. Free garage parking, private balcony, pool. |
| Modern 2BR in Cleveland | $341, down from $386 (~$114) | 2 bed, 3 beds, 1 bath. 4.72 stars (32 reviews). Superhost. In-unit laundry, gym, balcony. |
| Waterfront stay in Ohio City | $490 (~$163) | 2 bed, 2 queen beds, 2 bath. 4.93 stars (42 reviews). Riverside views, balcony. |
| Industrial loft downtown | $305 (~$102) | 1 bed, 1 queen bed, 1.5 bath. 5.0 stars (4 reviews). Likely tight for four people. |
| Ohio City retreat | $539 (~$180) | 2 bed, 3 beds, 2 bath. 4.95 stars (20 reviews). 1,138 sq ft, balcony, full kitchen. |
| Ohio City, 1 bedroom | $475 (~$158) | 1 bed, 2 beds, 1 bath. 5.0 stars (5 reviews). Balcony, private entrance. |

The downtown loft is the best fit: it has two bedrooms and two baths for four people, a strong rating, and a low price. The $341 listing is the cheapest of the two-bedroom options, but it has only one bath and a lower rating.

I filtered on the amenities but didn't open the individual listings, so check each one's pet rules and any pet fee before booking. The search page is still open in your browser.
